reason: My bookings and customers already run on WhatsApp and I already have a billing app, so this is ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month to do mostly what I do now. Getting my stylists to change how they work, after I already lost two last year, is not a fight I want for an app with my logo on it.
objection: Why switch? Zylu or MioSalon type apps already do billing and reminders, and if my staff find selfie check-ins and me watching everything from my phone annoying, I could lose more good people.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually catch missing cash or cancelled bills in a salon my size, and setup waived so I can try it without paying ₹4,999 first.
